open_points.subject: answer_request tools/call validation and tools/list inputSchema
open_points.text: - answer_request: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST check one request in exactly this order, the first failure deciding: the byte length of request_bytes is within the imported RELEASE_CEILING_SURFACE_REQUEST_BYTES_MAX constant, else invalid_request; authenticate_token with presented_token gives an Actor, else unauthorized with one fixed reason that reveals nothing about any record; for tools/call, the message names a catalogue operation and fits that operation's request model with no unknown field — a field typed X | None fitting when it is absent or JSON null — and every bound below, else invalid_request; the actor may call that operation by the actor table, else not_permitted; only then is the operation's handler called (A16 rule 1). initialize, ping and tools/list name no catalogue operation and are answered after the size and token checks, as the note on methods says.
open_points.other_text: - answer_request: [FIELD_PROJECTION] tools/list lists one tool per catalogue operation in State 5 catalogue order, each {name: the operation name, inputSchema: the schema of its request model}, derived only by this rule: a model is {"type": "object", "properties": its fields in declared order, "required": its fields not typed X | None, "additionalProperties": false}; str is {"type": "string"}, int {"type": "integer"}, X | None the schema of X, tuple[X, ...] {"type": "array", "items": the schema of X}, an enumeration {"type": "string", "enum": its members in declared order}, a Literal tag {"const": the tag}, and a discriminated union {"anyOf": the schemas of its variants in declared order}; no description, title or other keyword is added.
open_points.question: Must X | None fields accept JSON null, or must their advertised inputSchema exclude null by using only the schema of X?
